title: How Circle K accelerated DevOps incident triage to under 15 minutes with Amazon Bedrock
summary: Circle K's DevOps team cut incident triage from 45-60 minutes to under 15 by building an agentic triage system on Amazon Bedrock. This post walks through the architecture, the initial Amazon Bedrock Flows implementation, the migration to Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and the lessons
reason: Customer case-study/architecture post about Circle K building incident triage on existing Amazon Bedrock services. No new named model or capability release, no research artifact, no policy action, no business event, and no open-source tool release.
